summary: T1 item 8, digital partition: sim/characterization-digital-sta-area-power.md is the one aggregated, current artifact summarizing the digital partition's per-spec-row performance across the corner set, and it names the sim/records/ evidence record behind every number. It reports Fmax, placed area and power across all fifteen corners (the depth-2 family sim/records/2026-09-19-digital-sta-power-{01..15}.md, issue #255), which is exactly what item 8 asks a digital partition for, and its section 0 carries the FIFO_DEPTH = 2 re-measurement that supersedes the depth-8 sections 1-5a retained below it as append-only history. This envelope asserts that the aggregation artifact required by item 8 EXISTS and is CURRENT for the pinned revision of that document -- it does NOT assert that every row in it passes. Disclosed exceptions that travel with this claim rather than being omitted from it: (a) the placed cell area is 59 465.1 um^2, x1.767 of the depth-2 pre-synthesis inventory and still over the ratified < 0.05 mm^2 README row on digital cells alone; (b) measured power remains well above the library-based estimate at the same corner and rate; (c) the library max_transition check regressed from 0 of 15 corners violating to 11 of 15 at depth 2, tracked as open issue #264 (the six #233 inter-region trunk nets are not among the violators). All three are T1 item 5's subject matter, and item 5 is unmet in this manifest. See signoff/README.md for the full reading.
